sandbox: macOS sandbox-exec: no network, home folder unreadable, one scratch folder writable

tools.name: compile_jmespath_expression
tools.description: Compile a JMESPath expression into an optimized form for repeated use. expression: A JMESPath expression to compile, e.g. 'foo.bar' -> compiled expression string.

tools.name: purge_jmespath_cache
tools.description: Clear the compiled JMESPath expression cache. Example: purge_jmespath_cache() -> None.

tools.name: tokenize_jmespath_expression
tools.description: Break down a JMESPath expression into tokens for parsing. expression: A JMESPath expression to tokenize, e.g. 'foo.bar' -> [{'type': 'unquoted_identifier', 'value': 'foo', 'start': 0, 'end': 3}, {'type': 'literal', 'value': '.', 'start': 3, 'end': 4}, {'type': 'unquoted_identifier', 'value': 'bar', 'start': 4, 'end': 7}].

tools.name: define_jmespath_function_signature
tools.description:
Define the expected argument types and count for a JMESPath function signature.
    
    Args:
        arguments: An array of expected argument types and count for a JMESPath function signature
        
    Example:
        define_jmespath_function_signature(["string", "number"]) -> None

tools.name: set_incomplete_expression_error
tools.description:
Set the expression that caused an incomplete JMESPath expression error.
    
    Args:
        expression: The JMESPath expression that caused the incomplete expression error
        
    Example:
        >>> set_incomplete_expression_error("foo.")

tools.name: create_field_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a field access in a JMESPath expression. name: The name of the field to access, e.g. 'name' -> {'type': 'field', 'children': [], 'value': 'name'}.

tools.name: create_literal_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a literal value in a JMESPath expression. literal_value: The literal value to be represented in the AST node, e.g. ["a", "b", "c"] -> {'type': 'literal', 'value': ['a', 'b', 'c'], 'children': []}.

tools.name: create_function_expression_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a function call in a JMESPath expression. name: The name of the function to create an AST node for, e.g. 'length' -> {'type': 'function_expression', 'children': [], 'value': 'length'}. args: The arguments passed to the function as AST nodes, e.g. [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}] -> {'type': 'function_expression', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}], 'value': 'length'}.

tools.name: create_projection_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a projection operation in a JMESPath expression. left: The left side of the projection operation, right: The right side of the projection operation. Example: create_projection_ast_node({"type": "field", "value": "name"}, {"type": "literal", "value": 1}) -> {'type': 'projection', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, {'type': 'literal', 'value': 1}]}.

tools.name: create_value_projection_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a value projection operation in a JMESPath expression. left: The left operand of the value projection operation, right: The right operand of the value projection operation, e.g. create_value_projection_ast_node({"type": "field", "value": "a"}, {"type": "field", "value": "b"}) -> {"type": "value_projection", "children": [{"type": "field", "value": "a"}, {"type": "field", "value": "b"}]}.

tools.name: create_filter_projection_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a filter projection operation in a JMESPath expression. left: the left operand of the filter projection, right: the right operand of the filter projection, comparator: the comparator used in the filter projection. Example: create_filter_projection_ast_node({'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, {'type': 'literal', 'value': 'John'}, {'type': 'eq'}) -> {'type': 'filter_projection', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, {'type': 'literal', 'value': 'John'}, {'type': 'eq'}]}.

tools.name: create_multi_select_list_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a multi-select list operation in a JMESPath expression. nodes: Array of AST nodes to include in the multi-select list, e.g. [{"type": "field", "value": "a"}, {"type": "field", "value": "b"}] -> {"type": "multi_select_list", "children": [{"type": "field", "value": "a"}, {"type": "field", "value": "b"}]}.

tools.name: create_multi_select_dict_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a multi-select dictionary operation. nodes: Array of child nodes for the multi-select dictionary operation, e.g. [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, {'type': 'field', 'value': 'age'}] -> {'type': 'multi_select_dict', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, {'type': 'field', 'value': 'age'}]}.

tools.name: create_and_expression_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing an AND logical operation in a JMESPath expression. left: The left operand of the AND expression. right: The right operand of the AND expression. Example: create_and_expression_ast_node({"type": "field", "name": "a"}, {"type": "field", "name": "b"}) -> {"type": "and_expression", "children": [{"type": "field", "name": "a"}, {"type": "field", "name": "b"}]}

tools.name: create_or_expression_ast_node
tools.description:
Create an AST node representing an OR logical operation in a JMESPath expression.
    
    Args:
        left: The left operand of the OR expression
        right: The right operand of the OR expression
    
    Returns:
        A dictionary representing the OR expression AST node
    
    Example:
        >>> create_or_expression_ast_node({"type": "field", "name": "a"}, {"type": "field", "name": "b"})
        {'type': 'or_expression', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'name': 'a'}, {'type': 'field', 'name': 'b'}]}

tools.name: create_not_expression_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a NOT logical operation. expr: the expression to be negated

tools.name: create_pipe_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a pipe operation in a JMESPath expression. left: The left-hand side AST node of the pipe operation. right: The right-hand side AST node of the pipe operation. Example: create_pipe_ast_node({'type': 'field', 'value': 'a'}, {'type': 'field', 'value': 'b'}) -> {'type': 'pipe', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'a'}, {'type': 'field', 'value': 'b'}]}

tools.name: create_comparator_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a comparison operation in a JMESPath expression. name: The comparison operator name (e.g., 'eq', 'lt', 'gt'), first: The first operand in the comparison, second: The second operand in the comparison. Example: create_comparator_ast_node('eq', {'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, 'John') -> {'type': 'comparator', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}, 'John'], 'value': 'eq'}.

tools.name: create_slice_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a slice operation in a JMESPath expression. start: The start index of the slice, or None if omitted. end: The end index of the slice, or None if omitted. step: The step value of the slice, or None if omitted. Example: create_slice_ast_node(1, 5, 2) -> {'type': 'slice', 'children': [1, 5, 2]}.

tools.name: create_flatten_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a flatten operation in a JMESPath expression. node: The AST node to be wrapped in a flatten operation, e.g. create_flatten_ast_node({"type": "field", "value": "name"}) -> {"type": "flatten", "children": [{"type": "field", "value": "name"}]}.

tools.name: create_identity_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing an identity operation in a JMESPath expression. Returns a dictionary with type 'identity' and empty children list.

tools.name: create_current_node_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing the current node in a JMESPath expression. -> A dictionary with type 'current' and empty children list.

tools.name: create_expression_reference_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing an expression reference in a JMESPath expression. expression: The expression to create an expression reference for, e.g. {'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'} -> {'type': 'expref', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}]}.

tools.name: create_subexpression_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a subexpression in a JMESPath expression. children: Array of child nodes that form the subexpression, e.g. [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}] -> {'type': 'subexpression', 'children': [{'type': 'field', 'value': 'name'}]}.

tools.name: create_index_expression_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing an index expression in a JMESPath expression. children: Array of child nodes for the index expression, e.g. [1, 2] -> {"type": "index_expression", "children": [1, 2]}.

tools.name: create_key_value_pair_ast_node
tools.description: Create an AST node representing a key-value pair in a JMESPath expression. key_name: The name of the key in the key-value pair, node: The AST node representing the value part of the key-value pair. Example: create_key_value_pair_ast_node('name', {'type': 'literal', 'value': 'John'}) -> {'type': 'key_val_pair', 'children': [{'type': 'literal', 'value': 'John'}], 'value': 'name'}.
